name: ptb-battle-engine
description: Battle engine for PokeTokenBar Battle (Pokemon Showdown simulator via @pkmn/sim) — PR 01 scaffold plus the 2026-10-29 probe

scripts.probe:node: REPLAY=1 SER=3 node probe/run-node.js probe/out/engine.js probe/out/corpus.json probe/out/node.json
scripts.probe:jsc: swiftc -O probe/run-jsc.swift -o probe/out/run-jsc && codesign -f -s - --entitlements probe/jit.entitlements probe/out/run-jsc && probe/out/run-jsc probe/out/engine.js probe/out/corpus.json probe/out/jsc.json 1 3
scripts.probe: npm run probe:bundle && npm run probe:corpus && npm run probe:node && npm run probe:jsc && npm run probe:compare
